title: Cosmological Evidence for Dark Axion-Dark Baryon Interactions from Apparent Phantom Crossing
summary: Interactions between dark matter and dark energy can lead to an apparent phantom-crossing behavior that mimics the expansion history preferred by the latest cosmological observations from DESI baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO), Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB), and Type Ia supernovae (SNe Ia) data. In a previous paper [Khoury, Lin, and Trodden 2025 arXiv:2503.16415], we proposed a concrete particle physics realization of this idea, consisting of a strongly coupled dark sector in which a dark axion is coupled to dark baryons.
